premises.text: Customers face inefficiencies in finding last-minute personal services.
premises.evidence_span: it seemed really inefficient that I had to go through the painful process of dialing all of those merchants just to find one that was willing to take my money

premises.text: Bidzee allows customers to request personal services and name their own price.
premises.evidence_span: you can easily place a request for personal service, and you can even name your own price

premises.text: Merchants can accept bids from customers, allowing them to monetize idle time.
premises.evidence_span: a business gets a paying customer through the door, allowing them to monetize otherwise idle time

premises.text: Merchants prefer customer acquisition channels that are cost-effective and easy to set up.
premises.evidence_span: their consistent feedback about their available channels of customer acquisition was pretty simple. Firstly, they were too expensive, or they were too complicated to set up

premises.text: Bidzee provides merchants with bottom-of-the-funnel customers who have already committed to a purchase.
premises.evidence_span: they have bottom-of-the-funnel customers, who have already put a credit card behind their offer

premises.text: Bidzee connects customers with verified local businesses for services.
premises.evidence_span: Bidzee is only connecting you with a verified, rated local business in order to perform the service

value.text: Customers receive personal services on their terms while merchants gain new customers.
value.evidence_span: we give customers the deals and the services that they want on their terms and we allow merchants to bring more money through their door

notes: No separate premises for the various service types as they are part of the same offering.
